result.reason: The operative language substantially reaches the preferred position: it creates a mutual aggregate cap equal to the greater of 12 months’ fees and USD 1,000,000, retains the mutual consequential-damages exclusion, and makes all required categories uncapped. It also excludes Company’s fee-payment obligation from the cap. The revisions are targeted and preserve the remaining allocation of risk. Minor drafting deviations prevent a top score: the fee lookback runs from the event giving rise to the claim rather than the claim itself, and the payment carve-out refers only to fees rather than all Company payment obligations.
